svg.title: Businesses exposed, by town
svg.desc: Bar chart: Newcastle upon Tyne 36 of 47 exposed (77%), Gateshead 16 of 20 (80%), Sunderland 15 of 17 (88%), Middlesbrough 11 of 12 (92%), Durham 6 of 10 (60%). Towns with fewer than 10 businesses checked are not broken out. Same figures as the table below.
